import requestService from 'api/request' import VipReward from 'components/ui/VipReward' import { formatNumber } from 'lib/helpers' import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react' import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom' import { useAuthApp } from 'store/useAuthApp' import { useGlobalAppStore } from 'store/useGlobalApp' const Vip = () => { const navigate = useNavigate() const { user } = useAuthApp() const {configApp} = useGlobalAppStore() const [openVipReward, setOpenVipReward] = useState(false) const [data, setData] = useState(null) const getVipInfo = async () => { try { const res = await requestService.get('/profile/vip-info') if (res && res.data) { setData(res.data?.data) } } catch (error) { console.log(error); } } useEffect(() => { getVipInfo() }, []) return (
navigate(-1)} >

Specific description

Level A (direct invitation)

If a level A user purchases a project worth 1,000 dollars. You will receive a commission of {configApp?.vipReward?.reward_a}% ({1000 * configApp?.vipReward?.reward_a/100} USD) of his purchase amount

Level B (direct invitation of Level A)

If a Level B user purchases an item worth 1,000 USD. You will receive a commission of {configApp?.vipReward?.reward_b}% (({1000 * configApp?.vipReward?.reward_b / 100} USD)) of his purchase amount

Level C (direct invitation of Level B)

If a Level C user purchases an item worth 1,000 USD. You will receive a commission of {configApp?.vipReward?.reward_c}% ({configApp?.vipReward?.reward_c}% (({1000 * configApp?.vipReward?.reward_c / 100} USD))) of his purchase amount

Dividend Description

After completing the VIP level, you will activate your bonus. The higher the VIP level, the higher the bonus rate, up to 15%.{" "}

Example:

Example 1: Single downline

If your dividend rate is 15% and your directly invited downlines earn $5,000 per day, you will receive $750 in dividends per day.{" "}

Example 2: Multiple downlines

If you have 30 directly invited downlines and earn $5,000 per day, your dividend will be:

  • Daily dividend: 30 downlines × $5,000 × 15% = $22,500
  • Monthly dividend: 30 downlines × $5,000 × 30 days × 15% = $675,000
